items.title: Here are the countries withdrawing embassy staffers from Ukraine as fears of a Russian invasion mount - The Washington Post
items.snippet:
# These countries are withdrawing embassy staffers from Ukraine amid growing fears of an invasion by Russia

As tensions over the Russia-Ukraine conflict soared, the United States in late Januaryordered the departure of all family members of U.S. Embassy personnel, citing the “threat of Russian military action.” It also told nonessential staffers that they could leave.

items.title: Ukraine: Russia and Belarus hold joint military exercises | CNN
items.snippet:
The military drills, called “Allied Resolve-2022,” began in Belarus and will end February 20, the Russian Ministry of Defense announced Thursday in a statement.

“The purpose of the exercise is to work out the tasks of suppressing and repelling external aggression while conducting a defensive operation, countering terrorism and protecting the interests of the Union State,” the statement said. [...] On Thursday, the Russian Defense Ministry posted images of six large amphibious landing ships at the port of Sevastopol in Crimea, after they transited into the Black Sea earlier this week.
